title: PRL paper selected as Editor's Suggestion and Featured in Physics
content: Our paper *Stratification-Dependent Enstrophy-Controlled Regime in Geostrophic Turbulence* published in Physical Review Letters (136, 114101, 2026) has been selected as an **Editor's Suggestion** and **Featured in Physics**. The work experimentally reveals how baroclinic instability shapes the k⁻³ energy spectrum in geostrophic turbulence.

title: Oral presentation at the Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference
content: Presented our latest results on zonal jet flows and geostrophic turbulence in the rotating annulus experiment at the Geophysical and Astrophysical Fluid Dynamics Conference.

title: New paper published: Predicting IBL growth in stratified boundary layers
content: Our paper *Predicting full growth of internal boundary layers induced by a roughness change in neutrally and stably stratified circumstances* is published in Journal of Fluid Mechanics (1016: R4, 2025).

title: Paper published in Measurement Science and Technology
content: *Turbulence statistics estimation across a step change in roughness via interpretable network-based modelling* published in Meas. Sci. Technol. 36(1): 016026 (2025), with collaborators at University of Surrey.

title: New JFM paper on stratified boundary layer statistics
content: *Statistical properties of neutrally and stably stratified boundary layers in response to an abrupt change in surface roughness* published in Journal of Fluid Mechanics 986, A4 (2024).

title: Oral presentation at the Dynamics of Rotating Fluids Conference
content: Presented our work on rotating turbulence and zonal jet flows at the Dynamics of Rotating Fluids Conference.
